cathedral: Game environment atlas, THREE full room views stacked vertically, same exact camera and masonry geometry across all three panels. Each panel 1024 x 640 aspect, full atlas approximately 1024 x 1920. Reference image is style only. Theme: abandoned gothic cathedral, cold grey worn stone, tall carved sacred wall niches, a few tiny warm candles, no huge altar obstructing floor. Detailed sober gothic pixel art, realistic worn textures, crisp game art without cartoon outlines. Fixed elevated near-orthographic camera looking into a rectangular room, axes screen aligned and symmetric. Broad empty playable stone floor occupies center. Far north masonry wall occupies top 14% of each panel; narrow side masonry walls occupy left and right 6%; a continuous low foreground stone wall occupies bottom 9%, covering the FRONT edge. No painted rectangle border, no colored outline, no HUD, no text, no sprites or loose props. Precisely centered passage locations: north at x50%, y9%; west at x3%, y51%; east at x97%, y51%; south at x50%, y94%. All passage arches are BUILT INTO and carved from the room walls, NOT freestanding objects or separate surface pasted icons. Side recesses use SAME wall perspective as their surrounding masonry; no frontal tall skinny freestanding door icons. North entrance is a modest recessed stone tunnel. Foreground south passage is a walk-through break IN the continuous foreground wall, rear view of matching jambs. Top panel: seamless WALLS at all four locations, NO doors or openings anywhere. Middle panel: SAME exact room, same floor and walls and lighting, but four centered OPEN recessed passages in north/west/east/south walls, visibly dark interior, no glowing portals, no projecting door leaves. Bottom panel: SAME exact room and same four built-in passage frames as middle, but heavy dark wood and iron doors are CLOSED within each aperture. Preserve all pixels and architecture outside the four small door areas as closely as possible across all three panels. All portals aligned exactly across middle/bottom and reserved blank-wall positions of top. Do not crop any outer walls. No text, no panel labels, no grid, no borders between panels, no transparency. This art will be directly used as game background with localized door-state sampling.
